response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which permits returns of defective items regardless of the standard window. Although RET-008 would make the item ineligible (days_since_delivery 41 > 30), RET-020 has higher priority (90 vs 10) and controls. RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is False, and neither goodwill nor fraud-hold rules are triggered.
